verdict.rationale: SerpApi's own Searches Archive API lets users retrieve their past search results, and results are served in open formats (JSON by default, plus raw HTML or Markdown). The evidence covers only fetching individual searches, not a bulk export of all account data. missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account data export (search history, account and usage data), any stated retention guarantees for archived searches, offboarding or portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
